name: Gin
siboNotes: Pure distilled gin is FODMAP-free as alcohol distillation removes FODMAP compounds. However, alcohol can irritate the gut lining and may worsen SIBO symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Choose pure gin without added flavors or botanicals that may contain FODMAPs
Avoid gin cocktails with high-FODMAP mixers like apple juice or honey
Mix with low-FODMAP options like soda water, lime juice, or small amounts of cranberry juice
Consume in moderation as alcohol can disrupt gut bacteria balance
alternatives: Non-alcoholic gin alternatives with juniper extract
nutritionalHighlights: Contains approximately 64 calories per 1 oz serving
May contain trace amounts of botanicals like juniper
Provides no essential vitamins or minerals
